_meta: English summaries of the published concepts (title, format, teaser, promise). Full concept pages remain Dutch for now; /en/ pages link to them.

festival.title: The festival of tomorrow
headline: THE FESTIVAL
*OF TOMORROW.*
festival.teaser: A knowledge festival that feels like a journey of discovery. No endless rows of chairs, but encounters, experiments and ideas that stick.
festival.proposition: Not a classic conference, but a day that feels like an expedition. Meet, experiment and discover what is possible.

diner.title: The dinner that connects
headline: THE DINNER
*THAT CONNECTS.*
diner.teaser: More than eating together: an evening where stories, remarkable dishes and unexpected encounters come together.
diner.proposition: Food is the start. The real value lies in the stories, conversations and connections that follow.

ideeen.title: The day full of new ideas
headline: A DAY FULL OF
*NEW IDEAS.*
ideeen.teaser: A strategy day without a meeting room. Think, make, test and discover a new way of working together.
ideeen.proposition: An away day that starts with a question and ends with concrete plans. Out of routine, into imagination.

nacht.title: Night of wonder
headline: NIGHT
*OF WONDER.*
nacht.teaser: An evening that slowly unfolds: light, music, performances and surprising spaces that feel different than by day.
nacht.proposition: An evening that unfolds like a story. Light, music, food and special spaces change your perspective.

vergadering.title: The meeting that works
headline: THE MEETING
*THAT WORKS.*
vergadering.teaser: A meeting people want to make time for: short, sharp, in a place that gives focus, with decisions at the end.
vergadering.proposition: No twelve-point agenda in a room without daylight. Three questions, the right people and a design that leads to decisions.

teamdag.title: The team day outdoors
headline: THE TEAM DAY
*OUTDOORS.*
teamdag.teaser: A day away in which a team does something together, eats and celebrates. Active but achievable for everyone, with a warm finish.
teamdag.proposition: A team day that is not about winning, but about experiencing something together: being outside, making and eating together.

kennisontbijt.title: The knowledge breakfast
headline: THE KNOWLEDGE
*BREAKFAST.*
kennisontbijt.teaser: Start at 7:30, done by 10:30: one strong story, a good breakfast and conversations at themed tables.
kennisontbijt.proposition: A morning that does not swallow your diary: one story, two conversations and a breakfast you leave with new ideas.

walk-en-talk.title: The walk & talk meeting
headline: THE WALK & TALK
*MEETING.*
walk-en-talk.teaser: A meeting held outside: walking in pairs along questions, deciding back at the table. Calm in your head, clarity in the outcome.
walk-en-talk.proposition: Meeting while you walk. People who walk side by side talk differently: more honest, calmer and with more room for new ideas.

boardroomdiner.title: The boardroom dinner
headline: THE BOARDROOM
*DINNER.*
boardroomdiner.teaser: First one strategic conversation, then dinner together. A private evening for boards that asks for calm, discretion and a good conversation.
boardroomdiner.proposition: Meeting and dining in one evening: one strategic question at the table, with a menu that supports the conversation.

kick-off.title: The kick-off
headline: THE
*KICK-OFF.*
kick-off.teaser: An afternoon that launches a new year, plan or project: one story, one picture of the future and a team that gets going.
kick-off.proposition: Not a year plan on a screen, but an afternoon in which everyone feels where we are heading — and what their own role is.

maakplaats.title: The makerspace of tomorrow
headline: THE MAKERSPACE
*OF TOMORROW.*
maakplaats.teaser: A client day in which clients do not just hear about new developments, but experience them in small hands-on labs.
maakplaats.proposition: From inspiration to concrete innovation: clients discover in hands-on labs what new solutions mean for them.

jubileumavond.title: The anniversary evening
headline: THE ANNIVERSARY
*EVENING.*
jubileumavond.teaser: An evening that tells the history of the organisation and honours the people who made it — followed by a big party.
jubileumavond.proposition: You do not celebrate an anniversary with a speech, but with the stories of your people, a moment of pride and a party everyone remembers.

heidag.title: The strategy day
headline: THE STRATEGY
*DAY.*
heidag.teaser: A day away from the office with the management team or board: looking back, looking ahead and going home with three shared choices.
heidag.proposition: Not a full agenda in a meeting room, but a day in an inspiring place where you set the course together — and know who does what.

hybride-congres.title: The hybrid conference
headline: THE HYBRID
*CONFERENCE.*
hybride-congres.teaser: A conference that works for those in the room and those watching online: a tight programme, a dedicated stream host and interaction that connects both.
hybride-congres.proposition: Not a camera at the back of the room, but a conference designed for two audiences: equally good in the room and at home.

personeelsfeest.title: The staff party
headline: THE STAFF
*PARTY.*
personeelsfeest.teaser: An evening where everyone feels seen: a surprising theme, food that connects, a moment of thanks and then a real party.
personeelsfeest.proposition: Not drinks with a DJ in the canteen, but an evening with its own story, where colleagues meet each other differently and the company says thank you.

klantevent.title: The client event
headline: THE CLIENT
*EVENT.*
klantevent.teaser: An afternoon in a special place where you thank clients, give them an experience and have the conversation that leads to a follow-up.
klantevent.proposition: Not a relations day with a tour and a buffet, but an afternoon with its own story, where clients discover something new and you truly talk to them.

prijsuitreiking.title: The awards night
headline: THE AWARDS
*NIGHT.*
prijsuitreiking.teaser: An evening celebrating achievements: a tightly presented show, winners who really stand in the spotlight, and dinner and a party afterwards.
prijsuitreiking.proposition: Not a long list of names on a screen, but a show with suspense and stories, where every nominee feels seen.

tweedaagse.title: The two-day retreat
headline: THE TWO-DAY
*RETREAT.*
tweedaagse.teaser: Two days away with the team: working on content, eating together, an evening that connects and a second day where it all comes together.
tweedaagse.proposition: Not one long day you forget by evening, but two days with a night in between: time to think, talk and truly be together.

netwerkevent.title: The networking event
headline: THE NETWORKING
*EVENT.*
netwerkevent.teaser: A networking evening where people really meet: short inspiration, hosted conversations and drinks that work.
netwerkevent.proposition: Not drinks where everyone stays with their own colleagues, but an evening that organises encounters — with a reason to talk.

productlancering.title: The product launch
headline: THE
*LAUNCH.*
productlancering.teaser: A launch that lets people experience the product: a reveal with suspense, demos to try and stories that get shared.
productlancering.proposition: Not a press moment with a presentation, but an afternoon in which guests are the first to see, try and talk about the new product.

vrijwilligersavond.title: The volunteer evening
headline: THANK
*YOU.*
vrijwilligersavond.teaser: An evening to thank volunteers: personal, warm and without fuss — with stories, good food and a small surprise.
vrijwilligersavond.proposition: Not a formal reception, but an evening where volunteers feel their effort is seen, by the people they do it for.

online-event.title: The online event
headline: THE ONLINE
*EVENT.*
online-event.teaser: An online event that feels like a broadcast: from a real studio, with a host, short segments and interaction that works.
online-event.proposition: Not an endless video call with shared slides, but a tightly directed 90-minute broadcast in which viewers actively take part.
